name: Decide R06 policy using a 2x2 workload matrix
rationale: Dense left-recursive grammars at depth >= 64 achieve up to 2.16x speedup (0.4633x latency).
Sparse node capture (density 0) never crosses over and incurs +5% persistent snapshot overhead.
Shallow recursion (depth <= 16) suffers from 5-10% frame setup overhead.
Global promotion would penalize standard shallow grammars, violating performance directives.
Zero-overhead flat specialization guarantees zero penalty on flat grammars when compiled with shared output enabled.
